meta.note: Draft conflict groups for the 7-predicate construction predcls task. Groups are intentionally conservative and only cover predicates with plausible semantic confusion under real construction scenes.

conflict_groups.rationale: These predicates all describe close-range worker-worker or worker-object proximity. 'co_working_with' is usually a specialized human-human subset of spatial closeness, while 'next_to' is a stricter geometric version of 'near'.

These predicates all encode subject-object functional interaction or possession. 'operating' is a stronger machine-oriented form of 'using', while 'wearing' is a body-attached possession relation that may still compete with generic interaction cues under noisy real-scene annotations.
